text:
Use with caution / monitor.

Naproxen and anticoagulants such as warfarin have a synergistic effect on bleeding, leading to an increased risk of serious bleeding when used concomitantly compared to either drug alone [naproxen:drug_interactions:0]. Patients receiving this combination should be monitored for signs of bleeding [naproxen:drug_interactions:1, warfarin:drug_interactions:5].
